opening.argument: The material is presented as live scambaiting and an investigation into a Microsoft scammer and the Torpig virus, not as an offer to viewers. The presenter explains that he will show what the topic is, then describes pulling information from Google and searching for TorPig. The visible Google results page reinforces that search-oriented, explanatory setting. Nothing in the available evidence indicates a request for payment, credentials, or financial participation from the audience. Taken together, these observable features establish investigative testing and warning-oriented content rather than a solicitation.
